instruction.notes: GEMINI.md is Gemini CLI's hierarchical context file (global, project root and subdirectories are concatenated). The Copilot coding agent also reads GEMINI.md.

skills.notes: Discovery tiers, lowest to highest precedence: built-in, extension, user (~/.gemini/skills or ~/.agents/skills), workspace (.gemini/skills or .agents/skills). Within a tier the .agents/skills alias wins over the .gemini/skills directory.

quirks: Context files are concatenated, so a loader paragraph in GEMINI.md and the skill under .agents/skills/ do not duplicate each other — keep the paragraph short.
.agents/skills/ is shared with Codex, OpenCode and Copilot; .gemini/skills/ is Gemini-only.
